title: Compute brief - 12 October 2026
description: FERC keeps PJM's 50 MW large-load registry but rejects mandatory early curtailment of new data centers. Sesterce plans a EUR 10bn-plus, 200 to 600 MW AI campus in Jamsa, Finland with a signed anchor. Indiana approves AES's plan to serve Google's 390 MW Monrovia site. DigitalOcean B300 spot drops to $6.17. Tape: 68 confirms, 1 tick, 0 NEW.
og_kicker: FERC/PJM registry; Sesterce Finland; IURC Google 390 MW
lede: The grid rules moved more than prices over the long weekend. On 9 Oct FERC accepted PJM's 50 MW Large Load definition and registry, effective today, but rejected the interim service that would have let PJM curtail new data centers early in emergencies, so new AI load in the largest US market avoids forced early curtailment for now while PJM still runs about 6.8 GW short. In Finland, Sesterce plans a EUR 10bn-plus AI campus at the former Kaipola paper mill in Jamsa (200 MW first phase, 600 MW second) and says a contract with one of the two leading AI labs is signed. Indiana regulators approved AES Indiana's plan to serve Google's 390 MW Monrovia data center, the first under the state's large-load law. On the tape, DigitalOcean B300 spot fell to $6.17 from $8.00, now below its $7.94 12-month reserved rate; everything else confirmed: 68 confirms, 1 tick, 0 NEW.

countries.name: United States / PJM
countries.note: FERC ER26-3515 (9 Oct): 50 MW Large Load definition and registry effective 12 Oct; IRAS curtailment, BYONC and demand-curve exclusion rejected; PJM compliance filing due in 30 days (Wire).
